---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new game, improvement, or library enhancement
title: "[Feature] <short description>"
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A concise description of the feature or improvement you'd like to see.

## Motivation

Why is this useful? What problem does it solve or what use case does it enable?

## Proposed solution

Describe how you think it should be implemented. Include:
- Which files would need to change.
- Any new hardware features or pins required.
- Expected impact on flash / SRAM usage (the ATmega328P has only 32 KB / 2 KB).

## Alternatives considered

Have you considered other approaches? Why were they ruled out?

## Additional context

Sketches, links, references, or examples that support the request.
